title: Capacity forecasting from a fill rate
one_line: Estimate time-to-exhaustion by dividing remaining headroom by the recent fill rate, and act before the resource is full.

worked_examples.context: A filesystem is at 82% and has risen about 3 percentage points per day.
steps: Compute remaining headroom (to a safe ceiling, not 100%).
Divide headroom by the recent daily rate to get days-to-exhaustion.
Cross-check other early signals (PVC pressure, SMART pre-fail, memory pressure/OOM).
Recommend action before the projected exhaustion date, with margin.
worked_examples.result: State a concrete time-to-full estimate and act ahead of it, rather than reporting only the current percentage.

constraints.must: the forecast uses a rate (trend), not just the current level
constraints.violated_feedback: You reported a current level without a trend; a forecast needs a fill rate to project time-to-exhaustion.

misconceptions.belief: a resource is only a problem once it is full
misconceptions.correction: Act on the projected exhaustion time; waiting until full risks an outage with no lead time.
